svg.text: Which Mac Studio runs which models (decode speeds from community benchmarks)
Decode tok/s scales with memory bandwidth: tok/s ~ bandwidth / model size in GB (Q4 quant ~ 0.6 GB per B params)
TIER 1 - Mac Studio M5 Max 36-64 GB (460-614 GB/s, from $2,499)
8B-14B at high speed, 27B dense, 35B MoE at Q8. Fast chat, coding agents, RAG, Whisper-class audio.
8B Q4: 75-110 tok/s. Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B Q8: ~38 tok/s. 27B dense Q8: ~14 tok/s (Ollama).
Base 32-core GPU = 460 GB/s; 40-core option = 614 GB/s (Apple tech specs).
TIER 2 - Mac Studio M5 Max 128 GB (614 GB/s) - THE SWEET SPOT
70B dense Q4: 25-32 tok/s. gpt-oss-120B MoE: 14-19 tok/s. Llama 3.3 70B: 22.8 tok/s MLX at batch 1.
DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B MoE, IQ2): ~26 tok/s with 1M context in LM Studio. Nex-N2.5-mini 35B: 133.6 tok/s MLX.
70B Q4 needs ~40 GB weights + KV cache - 128 GB holds it with long-context headroom.
TIER 3 - Mac Studio M5 Ultra 96-512 GB (1.2 TB/s, from $5,499)
First quad-die UltraFusion chip. Llama 3.3 70B Q4: 42-52 tok/s. 120B MoE: ~43 tok/s. Qwen3-235B-A22B: ~37 tok/s.
512 GB tier: Llama 4 Maverick 400B (~245 GB, ~12 tok/s), Llama 3.1 405B Q4 (8-12 tok/s), GLM 753B (est. 17-22 tok/s).
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B: 60-85 tok/s in real agent loops (MacStories review on 256 GB).
512 GB option ships October 2026; 96/256 GB available at launch.
TIER 4 - Legacy M3 Ultra 512 GB and Mac Studio clusters (TB5 RDMA)
M3 Ultra 512 GB ran DeepSeek V3/R1 671B Q4 at 17-20+ tok/s (MLX) - now discontinued after the DRAM shortage.
Apple: 4 clustered Mac Studios = up to 3x faster distributed AI inference. EXO: up to 3.2x on 4 devices.
Mixed clusters work too: an M5 Max 128 GB + a 128 GB Strix Halo box over TB5 ran GLM-5.3 321B (IQ1) at 24 tok/s.
Sources: Apple newsroom + tech specs (Aug 2026), Presenc AI, ModelFit, LLMCheck, llamaperf, SpecPicks, Contra Collective, RunAIHome, MacRumors - speeds vary with runtime, quant and context.
